The Maid In/On The Green, X:11

This setting is based on Pádraig O’Keeffe, Julia Clifford and Denis Murphy’s playing on Kerry Fiddles
https://thesession.org/recordings/519
- I’m not convinced it is spot on, but it is close enough to give a flavour of their fine version of this excellent, widespread, popular jig. It is sufficiently different from other settings to justify an 11th entry here!
POK taught this to at least four of his pupils while, unusually, always giving it its name (often “in the Green”). The four versions I have seen are surprisingly different from each other, and from the KF setting. Read into that what you will. These links take you to three of them.
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig_okeeffe_horan_ms_029
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig_okeeffe_oconnor_mss_d_005
https://www.itma.ie/digital-library/score/padraig-okeeffe-ms-bk-4-21
The version in Dan Herlihy’s book (Sliabh Luachra Music Masters Vol 1, p39 tune 2) is an outlier; here is its abc:
d|gfg e2d|Bee dBA|Bee ABd|BAA ABd|
gfg e2d|Bee dBA|BGG FGABGG G3||
|gfg afd|gfg a2f|gfg afd|def g2a|
bff aff|gfg e2d|Bee dBA|BGG G3||
As an aside, while the written version finish with a long G (G3 or G2), the players on KF happily link sections with GBd. (See https://thesession.org/discussions/47525#comment950980 )
